info.modalSubtitle: Built from the TMDB movie database — a starfield of films you can move through.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Closer on the plane ≈ more alike in plot, genres, and languages; depth ≈ release date. Larger ≈ more votes (log scale); brighter ≈ higher TMDB average; color ≈ primary genre. Big is not always bright.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.body:
After loading: drag to orbit. Without Space: scroll wheel or timeline moves you along release-year depth. In macro roam, hold Space and scroll to dolly in; release Space to reset distance. Hover shows a one-line preview.

Search titles, people, or genres in the bar; ESC unwinds search, side sheet, then focus. Click a film for focus and the side sheet; click neighbors to switch.

sections.heading: Data & device
sections.body:
We build our offline galaxy from public movie listings (often starting from a free Kaggle snapshot). If you reuse raw data commercially, read TMDB, IMDb, and Kaggle terms yourself. Legal and third-party notes are in the GitHub repo [NOTICE](https://github.com/XYBuilds/chronicle_v3_3d_galaxy/blob/main/NOTICE).

Use a recent browser with hardware acceleration. The first visit downloads a large compressed pack—very old browsers or locked-down networks may not open it.

sections.heading: TMDB
sections.body: Film metadata and poster images are sourced from TMDB. See [TMDB API Terms of Use](https://www.themoviedb.org/documentation/api/terms-of-use) for API conditions.

sections.heading: Privacy
sections.body: No sign-in. We may turn on Cloudflare’s simple, mostly cookie-free stats for overall traffic and how fast the site feels—not to identify you or your film picks. Ad or privacy blockers can hide those pings; the galaxy still runs.
